19,358 reviews. 4.5 stars. And most tourists still skip Sunworld Hòn Thơm.

This is the world's longest non-stop cable car over open sea. 8km. You cross to a whole island with a water park, Roman-style architecture, and views that don't quit.

Book the combo ticket. Ride the cable car. Spend the day at Hòn Thơm island. Come back before sunset.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
